uniqueTitles.details: 100% unique titles across all tool and core pages.

singleH1PerRoute.details: Exactly one H1 tag per page, matching search intent.

canonicalTagCompliance.details: Self-referencing canonical tag present on every indexable route.

structuredData.details: Valid JSON-LD schemas (SoftwareApplication, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage, WebSite) generated dynamically.

breadcrumbs.details: Visual and JSON-LD breadcrumb trails configured for every sub-route.

faqs.details: Unique 5-8 item FAQ accordions present on all tool pages.

internalLinks.details: Related tools grid and contextual footer/header navigation links present.

sitemapAndRobots.details: /sitemap.xml and /robots.txt configured with zero disallow conflicts.

noIndexPrivateRoutes.details: Private auth and temporary endpoints excluded from sitemap and blocked in robots.txt.
